# D-0009: Scenes are generated by editor code

**Status:** Proposed | **Date:** 2026-10-14 | **Area:** Architecture

## Context
Inspector values in scenes silently override code defaults (Norm's InsignificAnts rule: never trust a serialized
default), and Claude cannot see the inspector.

## Decision
`MainSceneBuilder` builds `Assets/Scenes/Main.unity` and its supporting assets (panel settings, placeholder
material) from code; `ProjectSetup` applies player settings. Run them from the Statecraft menu or
`Tools/unity.ps1 -Mode setup`. The scene is never edited by hand; Norm's art is referenced from code.

## Because
Every value lives in reviewable code, the scene is reproducible, and Claude can change it. Cost: tweaks made in
the editor are lost on the next rebuild unless moved into the builder (Norm tells Claude). Same pattern as Sol's
Box's scene builder.
